sec.title: September 5 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 821)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 5** across Duke Ellington live from Broadway's Hurricane Restaurant (1943), Jack Benny's satirical Labor Day broadcast on *The Jell-O Program* (1932), true-crime LAPD dispatches on *Calling All Cars* for Rio Grande Oil (1934), Latin swing on *The Rudy Vallee Show* with Shirley Ross and Xavier Cugat (1940), the pilot of *You Don't Say!* featuring the BBC *Navy Lark* troupe (1970), and patriotic airs by the USAF Concert Band on *Serenade in Blue* (1954), Jack Benny (1932), James E. Davis (1934), Rudy Vallee (1940), and Duke Ellington (1943):
